title: 'git vouch setup', 'sync', 'status'
description: setup: store vouch.registry (default kernel registry on git.kernel.org), set gpg.format=ssh, gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile, gpg.ssh.revocationFile, first sync. sync: fetch with a refspec without '+' so rewinds are refused, then check and export. status: registry commit, fetch age with warning past 7 days, own tier.
acceptance_criteria: Tests against a local bare repo: sync refuses a force-pushed rewind; stale-fetch warning appears past 7 days and command still succeeds; setup writes expected git config in a temp HOME.
notes: Per DESIGN.md 2026-10-22: setup/sync save --min-tier/--include-automation to git config and reuse them; sync writes the revocation file even when check fails on something else; status shows fetch age and warnings.
